structuredOutputs.uncertainties: A March 6, 2024 Chronosphere page summarizes the company as having 'raised $120 million in Series C funding at a $1.6 billion valuation since February 2023,' which differs from the Jan. 10, 2023 PR Newswire announcement of an 'additional $115 million Series C' round. Based on the dated financing announcement, the clearest evidenced latest round announcement is the $115 million additional Series C on 2023-01-10. The sources reviewed do not explicitly identify lead investors for that extension, only new and participating investors. No separate legal closing date for the financing was found. The Palo Alto Networks press release clearly establishes completion of the acquisition on 2026-01-29; no IPO evidence was found before that date.
